verdict.rationale: Justworks documents that employees enroll themselves and that during enrollment it collects filing status, withholding, and exemption information, replacing the W-4. That covers the W-4 portion of a self-serve new-hire flow. The other onboarding evidence describes company enrollment into the PEO, not new-hire onboarding. Missing for 10: I-9 collection, bank/direct-deposit details collection, an ops user sending the new hire an invite or onboarding flow, completion before the start date, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
